altChecks.alt: AI-generated fashion image of four fictional adult women in a warm rooftop-window atelier. Three wear yellow, green and red horizontal-striped minis; the fourth wears dark green. A standing pair embraces beside a seated friend while another leans in and touches her hair. Braided and high-ponytail hairstyles, varied heels, a crescent arm tattoo, brass seating and terracotta roofs are visible.

AI-generated fictional Lithuania fashion editorial: four adult women lean together around pale-blue seating and a coral stool beside a lake window. Blue wave-patterned, yellow-green-red flag-inspired and silver mini outfits pair with varied heels and rainbow footwear. Rose and scorpion tattoos are visible. Distant fire and mushroom-shaped smoke are imaginary effects, not real events.

AI-generated fictional Jamaica fashion editorial: four adult women share a back hug and handclasp on coral benches beside a harbour terrace. Emerald, coral-gold, turquoise and green-black-gold outfits pair with rainbow, coral and turquoise footwear. Agency and abstract arm motifs are visible. Distant fires, smoke and a mushroom-shaped cloud are imaginary effects, not real events.

AI-generated fictional Jamaica fashion editorial: four adult women lean into a group hug beside mountain-facing windows. Indigo-ivory and green-black-gold minis and a graphite top with emerald skort pair with rainbow stockings and varied footwear. Large IA letters appear on one upper arm. Distant fires, smoke and a mushroom-shaped cloud are imaginary effects, not real events.
